user.title: Green Hero
user.description: Choose how to connect your Green Hero account.

browser.title: Log in to Green Hero
browser.description:
1. Open this link and sign in:

[Sign in to Green Hero]({url})

2. You'll land on the Green Hero web app, possibly a blank or error page — that's expected.
3. Copy the **full URL** from your browser's address bar (it ends in `#/code=...&state=...`) and paste it below.

Use the link above, not the normal Green Hero login: a URL with `?code=` comes from the Green Hero app's own login and won't work.

refresh_token.title: Green Hero refresh token
refresh_token.description: Paste a refresh_token from a logged-in Green Hero web session (browser console: read the `@@auth0spajs@@` localStorage entry).

error.invalid_auth: Could not authenticate with that value (the code may have expired or already been used). Open the sign-in link again and paste the new URL straight away.
error.invalid_code: Couldn't find a code in what you pasted. Paste the full redirect URL.
error.state_mismatch: That URL is from a different login (probably the Green Hero app's own). Open the sign-in link above and paste the URL you land on.
error.no_refresh_token: Login succeeded but no refresh token was returned. Try again.
